title: absolute-position-behavior
description: Abstracting the positioning behavior to be resusable in other elements

attributes.name: allow-overlap
attributes.description: Element has absolututely positioned children, such as menus and tooltips that are allowed to overlap the target

attributes.name: auto
attributes.description: Element is positioned from connected to disconnected? Otherwise setPosition and unsetPosition must be called manually.

attributes.name: fit-to-visible-bounds
attributes.description: If true, no parts of the tooltip will ever be shown offscreen.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: If true, no parts of the tooltip will ever be shown offscreen.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: The id of the element that the tooltip is anchored to. This element must be a sibling of the tooltip. If this property is not set, then the tooltip will be centered to the parent node containing it.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: The spacing between the top of the tooltip and the element it is anchored to.

attributes.name: sticky
attributes.description: Stays on screen while target is on screen

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Positions the tooltip to the top, right, bottom, left of its content.

attributes.name: position-align
attributes.description: Aligns at the start, or end fo target. Default is centered.
